name: notes_write

ops.description: Write operations, one flat object per op, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

itemId.description: Id of the work item that owns the note: a full UUID or 8 to 32 hex characters of one.

key.description: Note key, unique per item (1 to 200 characters, case-sensitive).

role.description: Note role: queue, work or review (case-insensitive). [ops: upsert]

body.description: Inline note text (may be empty). Exactly one of body and bodyFromFile is required. [ops: upsert]

bodyFromFile.description: Server-side path whose text becomes the body. Exactly one of body and bodyFromFile is required. Resolved strictly inside the agent config root: no absolute path, no '..', no symlink out of it; a regular UTF-8 file of at most 65536 bytes; CRLF becomes LF. An idempotency replay does not re-read the file. [ops: upsert]

expectedVersion.description: Guard on the note's version: omit to write unconditionally, 0 to require that the note does not exist, n to require that its current version is n. Anything else is version_conflict and nothing is written.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Create, replace or delete notes on work items, in batches. Every element commits on its own unless atomic is true. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
